label: Viber
terms_note: Bots only, and since 5 Feb 2024 'Viber bots can only be created on commercial terms' (no free bots). Base https://chatapi.viber.com/pa/ with header X-Viber-Auth-Token; set_webhook with event_types — message, subscribed, unsubscribed are mandatory; also conversation_started, delivered, seen. send_message only to SUBSCRIBED users (the single exception: a welcome message within 5 minutes of conversation_started); types text / picture / video / file / location / contact / sticker / rich_media (carousel) / url; keyboards; broadcast_message ≤300 receivers per call; rate limit 500 requests per 10-second window; get_account_info for identity.

sdks: Official Viber bot libraries (Node.js, Python) — developers.viber.com

reference.limits: - **500 requests per 10-second window**; `status` non-zero in the JSON body = error (e.g. 6 notSubscribed). - Only subscribed users can be messaged → cold outreach is impossible; unsubscribe handled by Viber (`unsubscribed` event must suppress the contact). Commercial contract governs volume pricing.

fields.name: auth_token
fields.help: Bot authentication token ('Each API request must include an HTTP Header called X-Viber-Auth-Token containing the account's authentication token'), shown in the bot's edit-info screen / Viber Admin Panel.

config_fields.name: sender_name
config_fields.help: sender.name shown with every message ('required. Max 28 characters').

me.note: get_account_info: id, name, uri, icon, subscribers_count, webhook.

send.note: `to` is the Viber user id of a subscriber (from a webhook callback); only subscribed users can be messaged. message_id is Viber's message_token. A non-zero Viber status (e.g. 6 notSubscribed) is an isError result.

not_offered.list_inbound: Inbound messages arrive only as callbacks to the webhook set with set_webhook ('This webhook will be used for receiving callbacks and user messages from Viber', https://developers.viber.com/docs/api/rest-bot-api/#webhooks); there is no polling endpoint.
not_offered.get_thread: No conversation history endpoint exists; messages reach the bot only through webhook callbacks (https://developers.viber.com/docs/api/rest-bot-api/#callbacks).
not_offered.reply: The REST Bot API has no reply/thread parameter on send_message (https://developers.viber.com/docs/api/rest-bot-api/#send-message); use send to the same user.
not_offered.mark_read: Read state exists only as incoming `seen` callbacks (https://developers.viber.com/docs/api/rest-bot-api/#callbacks); a bot cannot mark messages read.

adapter.envelope_note: Viber answers HTTP 200 with 'status': 0 and 'status_message': 'ok' on success and a non-zero status with the reason in status_message on failure (https://developers.viber.com/docs/api/rest-bot-api/#error-codes); non-zero statuses become isError results.

evidence: probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 200 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
